mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates exceeding 4.0% signal economic weakness and reduced corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the following 5 trading days as market participants price in deteriorating economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of aggressive monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and persistently high inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized > 5.0%) creates a 'higher for longer' rate environment that pressures equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the following 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Robust job growth indicated by rising nonfarm payrolls supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the labor market strength translates into economic expansion.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production exceeding 1.0% from the prior month reflects weakening manufacturing activity and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO declines > 1.0% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Recessionary conditions marked by negative annualized GDP growth (GDPC1) lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the following 60 trading days as economic contraction reduces corporate profits and increases risk aversion among investors.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy combined with labor market deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated financial stress and economic uncertainty.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp from prior month
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp from prior month.
